text:
emily: Originating RC rc-origami with artifact sha:0f1e2d3c. Small runtime tweak to attention caching targeting dedicated pools. Change window 04:00-05:00 UTC. Need a quick sheriff + QA ack for canary plan.

deploy-bot: [CI] rc-origami build passed (unit/integration/smoke). Release notes staged: https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-origami

ken: confirm no DB schema changes and flags scoped?

emily: No DB work. flags: `attention.cache.mode = { scope: "rc-origami" }`. Scoped to routing tag `dedicated-v2`.

qa-runner: Ran staging smoke. p50/p90 fine, p99 +5% within SLO. Canine harness green. +1 for canary.

sheriff: I'll cover quiet window. Need commit sha and explicit rollback steps. Abort thresholds?

emily: commit sha 0f1e2d3c. Rollback: pin artifact to rc-stable sha:aa55aa55 and immediate routing fallback to smaller model variant. Abort if error rate >1.2% or p99 +40% sustained for 10m. Runbook: /runbooks/rc-rollback.md

deploy-bot: Promotion command example:
```
/deploy promote --env=prod --rc=rc-origami --artifact=sha:0f1e2d3c \
  --canary-stages=1,10,100 --quiet-window=04:00-05:00UTC --notify=@sheriff \
  --notes-url=https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-origami
```

emily: requesting 1% for 8m, 10% for 20m, then full. Watch rerank_exact_match and token-cost.

deploy-bot: ACTION by emily: scheduled promotion at 04:02 UTC. Stage 1: 1% canary deployed. Health checks passing.

qa-runner: quick smoke on canary looks clean.

deploy-bot: Stage 2: moving to 10% traffic... routing updated. Health: passing. Telemetry: minor p99 blip but below threshold.

sheriff: observing dashboards. error rate 0.3%, p99 stable.

emily: proceeding to full after 18m if stable.

deploy-bot: Stage 3: promoting to 100% traffic. Rolling update across zones.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. All regions at rc-origami sha:0f1e2d3c. Post-deploy checks OK.

qa-runner: extended evals running. No regressions so far.

sheriff: marking rollout stable. Closing quiet window early at 04:40 UTC.

emily: pinning artifact to rc/origami/2026 and updating changelog. If any regression crosses thresholds, use:
```
/deploy rollback --env=prod --to-artifact=sha:aa55aa55 --reason="regression"
```

deploy-bot: Postdeploy watch active (30m). Auto-create rollback ticket on threshold breach. Thanks everyone.
